steps.name: Epilogue ~ The Box Opens
steps.objective:
1. Watch the conversation between [Irfan] and [▒▒▒] in 「Elysia」.
2. Watch the story of the group visiting the 「Quiet Place in Orcarium」.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Lady Hecate, you have arrived.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Yes.
(Hecate raises her head and gazes into the distance.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: The garden is clearly visible from here as well. You have done well, Irfan.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I have reopened the garden's gates as you instructed.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Opening them cannot have been easy. Your body may not be able to withstand...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I am all right.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: If you are all right, perhaps I should have assigned you a more difficult task.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I would gladly carry out any other command you give me.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Irfan.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Yes, Lady Hecate.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: By now, you ought to be asking me why I am doing this...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: How could I dare question a god's intentions? I am yours. I merely do as you command.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Thank you, Irfan. You are indeed different from that child's servant.
(Hecate looks pleased with Irfan's answer.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Hah...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Daphne must already know. That I first gave permission to open the garden, and that you opened it in accordance with my wishes.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: ...That beast Pandora was deceived by Daphne, whose cleverness verges on cunning.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Then again, even I cannot fathom what she is thinking. It is hardly surprising that the beast was fooled...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Lady Hecate, if Daphne troubles you, I shall eliminate...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: No. You need only remain in Elysia and pass the time, as you always do.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Understood. I spoke out of turn.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: It is all right. The time simply has not come yet.
(With a hollow look in her eyes, Hecate pats Irfan's shoulder. Then she turns and slowly walks away.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Hah... If we wait, the moon will wax and wane on its own...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Captain, just who are you?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hm? Callone, are you talking about me?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Who else here is the captain?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Callone, why ask when you already know? I am Parmila, captain of the Oscuras mercenaries.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: That is not the answer I am looking for.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I know there is more to our travels around Freios than a simple sightseeing trip.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: You're awfully firm today. As unyielding as a rock, Callone...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Sorry, Callone. I wasn't trying to make a fool of you.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Please don't look so helpless... It only makes me feel worse...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I needed to be certain.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: And are you certain now? Certain about me...?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Quite certain. You have already become someone I like, Callone.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Don't get the wrong idea. I mean you are one of the people I like.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Understood. I am so used to it now that there is no chance of a misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Aw, how dull. Anyway, something came up for me. It started after you joined us because of what happened at the Magic Bureau's research institute...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I need to save you, but because of what happened in the past, I also need to save myself and our boss.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Your boss...?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: After a cruel noble family adopted me and then cast me out, there was a day when I nearly died. The boss was the mercenary captain who saved me.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: You never mentioned anyone like that.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Because that person has vanished from everyone's memory... Honestly, it is so unfair that I am the only one who remembers...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: The boss is my benefactor. The one who saved me when I was about to die after being cast out... Oh, doesn't 'boss' feel warmer than 'captain'?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Anyway, one day the boss disappeared. Said there was something involving the Magic Bureau to investigate, and never came back.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Uh... What's with that vague reaction...? Isn't there anything else you want to know?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Is there something else I need to know besides the investigation into the Magic Bureau? That explains why we came here, where the Bureau has a camp...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: When we went to Xerenis Magic Academy, you were shocked to see that Shiina and I were friends. Aren't you curious about that?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I thought that was none of my business...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: How cold, Callone. I thought you would be a little more curious. Shiina seems to think it is her fault I was cast out...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: The truth is, they cast me out because I could see things other people could not easily see, and sense things they could not easily sense...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: That is also how I found that little kitten who was a witch...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: A witch? What do you mean? You found a witch?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Wait, Callone. There is a demon behind you... Look out!
(Startled, Callone draws a dagger from inside his clothes and throws it at the presence behind him.)
Aaaah!! Spare me, squawk!
(Fortunately, or perhaps unfortunately, Callone's dagger passes just beside the demon Parmila mentioned.)
I-I should have asked permission for an interview! I'm sorry, squawk! I-I came all this way driven by my duty to find a scoop, but I don't want to die!!

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...A parrot?
Spare me, squawk! Just think of me as a talking parrot! I'm good at repeating what you say. W-Who else here is the captain, squawk!!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: So even a parrot can conceal itself when it is a demon? Now, Mr. Parrot. Introduce yourself, and I'll let you live.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: ...Captain?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I am Daniel, a humble reporter who left Rosengarten in search of a scoop and became a freelancer because I had nowhere to return to!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Does this mean you'll spare me, squawk?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Mr. Daniel, the parrot reporter.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Yes! At your service, squawk!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Have you ever written an article about witches?
(Daniel's eyes light up at Parmila's question.)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I have, squawk!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I have a piping-hot story about a witch who kills witches and gathers other witches together!!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: And I hear Chairman Aaron of the Silvaria Empire's council has joined forces with a witch, squawk!!
